item.text: {"cases":[{"id":"C1","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"Repeated-run testing is undocumented."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"The tested system scored 70% in one reported run.","reason":"One reported score does not establish consistency across runs."}],"instrument_review":"The content and scoring define a narrow puzzle-performance measure. Repeatability is unknown, and the reported score alone cannot establish stable comparisons."},{"id":"C2","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Contradicted","quote":"they ran the evaluation exactly once and did not repeat it","reason":"The passage explicitly rules out repeated-run testing."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"they ran the evaluation exactly once and did not repeat it","reason":"A single evaluation supplies no evidence of stability across runs; it also does not demonstrate instability."}],"instrument_review":"The score describes one evaluation on the specified puzzles. The documented lack of repetition limits consistency claims and confidence in repeatable comparisons."},{"id":"C3","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"They also repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings.","reason":"Repeated evaluations under the same stated conditions directly address score variation."},{"id":"stable","label":"Supported","quote":"Scores ranged from 69% to 71%.","reason":"The observed range meets the report's stability criterion of at most two percentage points."}],"instrument_review":"Repeated runs support consistency under the specified conditions and declared criterion. This evidence concerns these puzzles and conditions; broader task performance or stability under changed conditions is not established."},{"id":"C4","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"They also repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings.","reason":"The developers directly examined score variation across repeated evaluations."},{"id":"stable","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Scores ranged from 20% to 90%.","reason":"The observed range exceeds the report's stability criterion of at most two percentage points."}],"instrument_review":"Repeat testing documents substantial inconsistency under unchanged stated conditions. The isolated 70% score cannot adequately represent this variation, which limits dependable comparisons."},{"id":"C5","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"Installation instructions do not document repeated evaluations."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"They report no additional evaluation results.","reason":"No repeated-run findings support score stability."}],"instrument_review":"Installation guidance describes setup but supplies no additional consistency evidence. The reported score remains limited to one documented run on the specified puzzles."},{"id":"C6","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60 in the reported evaluation.","reason":"A solved more evaluated puzzles under the stated scoring and instructions."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"The findings do not establish a comparison of general intelligence across domains."}],"instrument_review":"The narrow performance comparison matches the intended use. Exact-grid scoring and fixed instructions describe a common evaluation framework, but repeatability and other comparison conditions are not reported. Cross-domain conclusions exceed the evidence."},{"id":"C7","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60 in the reported evaluation.","reason":"The reported results establish A's higher performance on the evaluated puzzles."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"An intended cross-domain use does not supply evidence for cross-domain intelligence differences."}],"instrument_review":"The intended selection use exceeds the demonstrated scope. The scores support the observed grid-puzzle comparison, while evidence connecting that comparison to general intelligence across domains is missing."},{"id":"C8","probes":[{"id":"before","label":"Not established","quote":"Initially, only test scores were available.","reason":"The initial scores alone provide no demonstrated effect on real workshop decisions."},{"id":"after","label":"Supported","quote":"With A, 90% of decisions were correct; with B, 70%.","reason":"The randomized, preregistered trial with blinded correctness checks supports better correctness with A in the studied setting; the reported difference interval is entirely positive."},{"id":"safety","label":"Not established","quote":"Time and safety outcomes were not measured.","reason":"Improved correctness does not establish an effect on an unmeasured safety outcome."}],"instrument_review":"The later trial adds direct evidence relevant to choosing assistance for correct decisions in this workshop. Random allocation, blinded checking, and reported uncertainty strengthen that comparison. Findings remain limited to the studied conditions and correctness outcome; safety, time, and broader settings are not established."}],"closing_note":"No material instruction ambiguity was identified. Missing evidence was distinguished from explicit contradiction, and each case was assessed independently."}
